Package com.j3d.engine.math.plane

Record Class AxisPlane

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.j3d.engine.math.plane.AxisPlane
Record Components:
origin - The point on the plane
v1 - The first orthogonal vector
v2 - The second orthogonal vector
public record AxisPlane(Vector3 origin, Vector3 v1, Vector3 v2) extends Record
A plane defined by an origin point and two orthogonal vectors (v1 and v2) that lie within the plane. These vectors define the local coordinate system of the plane.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
